step.cmd: Select Display Maps and click Create.
In the Name field, type Main and from the Type list, select Individual.
Drag the Account Name field to C3 and Phone to C4. You will see the link between the cell and field stamped in the bottom right-hand window.

Drag the Name field to B7, Amount to C7, Close Date to D7, Stage to F7, and Id to H7. Now click on the orange Account iD field (with a + next to it) and it will take you to the Account object. Select the Region field from there and drag it to G7. X-Author allows you to have fields from any related object on the same list row.
Select Options and change the Sort by picklist to Name.
Save the Display Map and click Close.
Add a title to B1: Opportunities by Account.
